title: Fix three bugs in a Go TTL cache
description: Fix bugs in TTLCache: Set doesn't add TTL to expiry, Get returns expired entries, Len has off-by-one.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in ttlcache.go:
1. Set: change `expiry: time.Now()` to `expiry: time.Now().Add(ttl)`
2. Get: change `time.Now().Before(e.expiry)` to `time.Now().After(e.expiry)` (entry is expired when now is AFTER expiry)
3. Len: change `len(c.store) + 1` to `len(c.store)`
All 3 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
